svg.title: Arcade: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of an arcade: six round arches in a continuous wall, each carried on stout piers with an impost block at the springing, and a cornice running along the top, with a round close-up of one arch springing from its pier. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×5 · BAYS 3.6 m WIDE · ARCHES SPRING AT 4.2 m
